steps.fact: The left referent billing:Helion Robotics Limited corresponds to the billed name 'Helion Robotics Limited' on invoices.
The right referent registry:11847201 corresponds to company number 11847201 registered as HELION ROBOTICS LIMITED.

Commercial notes state that invoices and Companies House both use 'Helion Robotics Limited' and that this is the same legal entity (linking invoice billing to a Companies House registration by name only).
No observation states that the billed entity is company number 11847201, nor that the Companies House registration referenced in the notes is specifically registry entry 11847201.

Name correspondence between billing 'Helion Robotics Limited' and registry name HELION ROBOTICS LIMITED does not by itself establish identity to company number 11847201; the packet does not license name uniqueness.

support_claim: Billing and registry observations align on the name Helion Robotics Limited, but the packet never links the billed counterparty to company number 11847201, so identity between billing:Helion Robotics Limited and registry:11847201 is not established.
